details:
The gcc-toolset-16-gcc13 package contains the GNU Compiler Collection version 16.

Security Fix(es):

* gcc: Integer wrap in `std (CVE-2026-114691)

* gcc: Confirmed out-of-bounds read/write in libstdc++ parallel `std (CVE-2026-114690)

* gcc: Stack overflow in std::bitset on libstdc++ (CVE-2026-115455)

* gcc: Out-of-bounds read in std::from_chars (CVE-2026-115456)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
